Operating Guide
1

Position Hardware & Power On

Position scanner facing the Calamansi tree canopy and turn on the power switch.

Tip: Wipe camera lens clean before scanning.
2

Set Location & Sync Weather

Set municipality in Settings to sync live temperature and rainfall probabilities.

3

Run 360° Automated Scan

Tap Quick 360° Scan or step through angles 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°.

4

Run Gemini AI Analysis

Tap Gemini AI button to evaluate plant pathology across all 4 angles.

5

Review Agronomic Findings

Check Leaf & Fruit breakdown and prepare recommended DIY organic care recipes.

6

Apply Irrigation & Monitor Live

Apply smart drip irrigation (5–8L/tree) and monitor live field updates on mobile.

FAQ & Care

Best time to scan?

Early morning (7:00 AM) or late afternoon (5:00 PM) for diffuse sunlight.

What to do if rain is forecasted?

Hold foliar sprays for 48 hours to avoid wash-off loss.

How to maintain the turret motor?

Never force by hand. System automatically rewinds after each scan.
